paragraphs: The Discovery V8 was fitted to the first two generations of the Discovery — the D1 (1989–1998) and the D2 (1998–2004). Both used the same AJ41 petrol V8, offered in 3.9-litre form in the earlier cars and 4.0-litre in the later ones. It was the petrol flagship of the range during that era, sitting alongside the Tdi and Td5 diesel variants. The Discovery V8 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ41 engines for every Discovery V8 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.9-litre (D1) or 4.0-litre (D2) V8 petrol engine fitted to the Discovery from 1989 to 2004. No widely-reported engine issue for this variant — we still recommend a full inspection before any long journey. We replace timing chains, valve seals, coolant components, and bearings as standard on every rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The AJ41 V8 in the Discovery is a straightforward fitment across the D1 and D2 generations, but the capacity changed from 3.9 litres to 4.0 litres partway through production. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ41) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
